readings: For each observatory station that has at least one telescope, show the station (`observstation`), the average bandwidth usage of its telescopes (`bandusagepct`, ignoring missing values), the number of telescopes, and that number divided by the average telescope count across those stations. Sort by the ratio, largest first, and show the top 10.
queries:
WITH station_stats AS (
  SELECT
    observstation,
    AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct,
    COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
)
SELECT
  observstation,
  avg_bandusagepct,
  telescope_count,
  telescope_count / (SELECT AVG(telescope_count) FROM station_stats) AS count_ratio
FROM station_stats
ORDER BY count_ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
